count of maps in the generalisation corpus

claims.notes: [BATCH NOTE b073 RE-EXTRACT] Full re-extraction of lines 1-332 of the working-tree (uncommitted) body under charter § 5 rule 14 / ruling 18; replaces the earlier b073 file, whose line anchors and several figures (the § 3 image gap, the § 3 0.55-0.73 band sentence, the § 4.1 corrected-F1 row) no longer match the body. GROUND-TRUTH COUNTS: the canonical timeline in reports/verification/c4-triage/coverage-drift-2026-08-04.json (gt_count_era_resolution) establishes that the 2026-05-03 evaluations ran between curator additions baf1497a7 (4,744 to 4,745) and 2e075eb99 (4,745 to 4,746), so every 4,745 in this range is ERA-FAITHFUL. Such values are therefore anchored to an era artefact (the T=0.7 corrected-f1-multi-buffer summary, whose $.results[0].n_ref_student_only records the GT size the run consumed) or marked historical -- NEVER to the live inputs/vectors/references/student-mounds-55maps-reviewed.geojson, which holds 4,746 today; the superseded b073 anchored it to the live GeoJSON and would have manufactured a mismatch. Per claim, which treatment was used is stated in that claim's notes. The Dawid-Skene layer's own reference is the LEGACY student-mounds-55maps.geojson (4,770 features, per this document's own line 279-280) and is not conflated with the 4,746 student GT anywhere here. CHANGELOG / CORRECTION PAIRS: in every 'was X, now Y' or 'X -> Y' construction the old side carries method historical with path null (pre-recovery backups named in notes for triage) and the new side is a live read/arithmetic claim. SCOPE (rule 5): dates, timestamps, git hashes, session numbers, Obs/erratum/audit ids (Obs 293, D17 audit FALSE-12), candidate ids (cand 2397), section references (§3, §4.2), backup-filename timestamps, the year in 'Sobotkova et al. 2023', precision descriptors ('4 d.p.'), and the numbers inside condition and directory names (T=0.3, T=0.7, 55maps-text-high-t0.3-generalisation, the 384 in the bounds path) are not extracted. Compound modifiers used as names ('2-annotator fit', '2 x 2 cross-tab', 'four-way comparison') are not extracted; the cardinal 'two binary annotators' IS extracted where it asserts the design. The cardinal 'four'/'55' is extracted where it asserts study scope (lines 1 and 36) and skipped where it is a pronominal reference to the same comparison set ('the smallest of the four', 'across all four runs'). 'R = 50 m' / 'at R=50 m' used to identify which row or buffer a metric belongs to is treated as context, not a claim, except where the document asserts the D-S matching buffer itself (line 195). This document has no sibling JSON in results/55maps-ds-summary-v2/ (report.md is the only file), so all anchors are the per-run artefacts the report aggregates.
